recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key portrait of a male musician in profile, looking down at his instrument, set against a dark, atmospheric background with a structured typographic block on the right side featuring a mix of bold display fonts and a tracklist.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the left two-thirds with a dark, moody presence
Typography is clustered in the upper right quadrant to balance the visual weight
The microphone stand acts as a vertical divider between the portrait and the text block
Warm yellow and orange text accents contrast against the cool blue and black background
coreInvariants: Tight cropping on the musician's head and shoulders
A rectangular 'TV-screen' graphic frame for the secondary title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile portrait positioned on the left, facing right, filling approximately 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The musician's face, highlighted by a single directional light source.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the face on the left, following the gaze down to the hands/instrument, then up the microphone stand to the bold typography on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black background surrounding the subject and providing a canvas for the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and dark charcoal (background and clothing)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale blue (shirt and graphic frame background)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm yellow and salmon orange (primary typography)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall color saturation, creating a somber, serious mood.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke width in display elements
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'showtime' in a rounded, geometric sans-serif within a frame
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Condensed bold uppercase paired with rounded lowercase geometric forms.
graphicDevices: Rounded rectangular frame with an inner border
Vertical microphone stand as a compositional anchor

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed uppercase display style
Matches the geometric, rounded lowercase style in the graphic box

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key, high-contrast portrait of a man in a dark suit and light blue shirt, looking down in a pensive mood. The background should be nearly black. Include a vintage microphone on a stand in the mid-ground to the right of the subject.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a heavy condensed sans-serif in the top right. Below it, place a rounded blue rectangle with a white border containing lowercase geometric text. Align a list of song titles in small yellow sans-serif to the right edge.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-contrast and moody?
Is the typography condensed and bold?
Is the layout asymmetrical with text on the right?
Does the color palette feel like a 1960s print?

adjustableVariables: Specific accent colors (e.g., swapping orange for red)
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the dark background
Verify the 'TV-screen' graphic is correctly rendered
Confirm the microphone stand doesn't obscure the subject's face
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key portrait + condensed bold sans-serif + right-aligned metadata block + 1960s muted palette.
